properties.name: neon.app.web-url
properties.description: Where the browser goes after a Keycloak login and logout: the Flutter web app (`flutter run -d chrome --web-port 5050`). Only this setting decides it, never a request parameter (no open redirect); Keycloak must allow it as a post-logout redirect.

properties.name: neon.security.users.*.password
properties.description: A hash with its encoder id (`{argon2}...`), never the password: a plain password stops the start.

properties.name: neon.shop.max-basket-size
properties.description: Books per basket, all titles together.
